messages.subject: Mediation - dates and mediator
messages.plaintextBody:
Elena,

Further to the parties' agreement to mediate, we propose 6 November at IDRS in London, with John Ardle as mediator. Position papers exchanged 3 November. Does that work for your side?

Nadia Iqbal
Pemberton Rowe LLP
